dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Hi Mei-Lin, this is the intake line at SMD's partner law firm. I understand you'd like to talk about a intersection T-bone collision. Is now still a good time?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: Yes, thanks for calling back. So on 2026-04-13 I was picking up my kids from school when intersection T-bone collision happened.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what injuries you've experienced, and whether you've gotten medical treatment?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: I've been having knee pain. I went to Copper Canyon Imaging the next day. They referred me to an imaging center.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Did you exchange information with the other party? Do you know who their insurance is with?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: Yes, Cascade Bay Insurance. The police were also there.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Have you spoken with the insurance company yet?

dialogue.speaker: client
dialogue.text: Yes, they offered $3,500 already and I said I'd think about it.

dialogue.speaker: intake
dialogue.text: Got it. One more question — have you worked with another attorney on this matter, or signed anything with another firm?
